description: Inject Trellis project instructions at runtime instead of writing external wiki paths into AGENTS.md
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- Deliver Trellis workflow, spec, workspace and task navigation through existing SessionStart hooks, extensions, plugins and manual startup context, resolving paths from the current checkout locator.

**Bug Fixes:**
- Stop creating or appending Trellis-managed AGENTS.md content. Ordinary update removes complete legacy managed blocks while preserving all surrounding user text and respecting backups, conflict decisions and update.skip. Successful cleanup retires the AGENTS.md receipt; skipped cleanups remain retryable.
- Align init and update rendering of external workflow and runtime-agent documents so a fresh installation immediately passes update --dry-run without template churn.
- Remove template-only external-store typing imports when generating standalone Python hooks so inlined store types are not redeclared.
notes: No data migration is required for external wiki projects. Platforms without startup hooks continue to use existing Trellis skills/commands. Malformed blocks and instruction-file symlinks are preserved. Other generated skill/command path rendering is unchanged.
